name: AnymeX+ β (Beta)
subtitle: AnymeX+ beta builds
description: Beta builds of AnymeX+ (AnymeX with Stremio built in). Installs next to the normal app as AnymeX+ β, with its own sign-ins and library. New fixes land here first.

apps.name: AnymeX+ β
apps.subtitle: AnymeX+ beta builds
apps.localizedDescription: Beta builds of AnymeX+ (AnymeX with Stremio built in). Installs next to the normal app as AnymeX+ β, with its own sign-ins and library. New fixes land here first.
apps.versionDescription:
Beta v1.1.1-beta+8

- Beta 8: faster builds, easier AnymeX updates
  - AnymeX's own colour calls are back as they were: 117 AnymeX files no longer differ from AnymeX, so merges touch 36 files instead of 155
  - The weekly AnymeX check now also tries the merge and runs the checks; a "Ship AnymeX update to beta" button puts a ready merge in a beta
  - Builds: the iPhone and Windows builds start right away and run alongside the checks (the release still waits for them); the compiled Rust network library is kept between builds; rhttp's Rust packages are pinned
- wip: colour calls back, build speed-ups (lock file pending)
